summary: Small badge indicating status, review or boost states with optional icon and color variants. Supports an Ado-coloured `ado` status and a `size="compact"` (18px, 11px bold) pill, e.g. the "New" badge: `<StatusBadge status="ado" size="compact" hideIcon text="New" />`. A `variant="glass"` label (dark translucent fill with a blur, white 12px text) sits on photos: `<StatusBadge variant="glass" status="neutral" text="Image" />`.
